_doc: GOLDEN FIXTURE — S1.SH1A from Julian's locked 8-beat spine (beats 1-2: chase chaos → crash + gymnastic finish + the 'Nailed it' button). This file IS the direction; the engine compiles it. REVIEW CANDIDATE: direction fields adjustable at SEE sign-off; reference file paths are placeholders until Codex binds real assets.
purpose: Fuzzby's overcommitted flight ends in a crash he converts into an improvised gymnastic finish, sold as intentional — the first false triumph.

foley: moss impacts and one mushroom-cap boing
one pollen settle under the held pose

references.defines: the approved opening composition, Fuzzby's start position at the corridor's west entrance and the camera axis
references.ignore: identity, materials and any action after 0.0s

references.defines: Fuzzby's approved identity, proportions and canonical scale — refer to it strictly
the flower-corridor geography, palette, materials and sunlight behaviour
references.ignore: any characters or foreground action in it

references.defines: Fuzzby's performed line, its exact timing and all silences
references.ignore: anything beyond it except the authorised foley

geography: The corridor runs frame-left (west) to frame-right (east); Fuzzby travels west to east and never reverses.
The moss landing patch sits frame-right, just past the final flower.
Camera stays south of the corridor at bee height — never overhead.
light: Warm afternoon sun from upper frame-right; petals cast soft moving shadows; the moss patch sits in a clean pool of light.
conduct: Fuzzby plays proud authority, never distress — the crash is performed as if he meant it.
Comedy is TRUE, not BIG: the joke is the gap between poise and evidence.

stages.action: Fuzzby barrels down the corridor at full speed, clipping petal after petal; each snaps back and fires a puff of pollen behind him
stages.camera: low rear three-quarter track, offset left, matching his speed
stages.sound: rising wing-buzz, quick petal thwips in rhythm
stages.end_state: the final flower ahead, its gap clearly too tight for his speed

stages.action: his trailing wing catches the last stem; it loads, bends and twangs him forward off-axis into a tumble
stages.cause: too much speed into too tight a gap
stages.camera: the track continues, keeping the stem contact in frame
stages.sound: buzz stutter, one clean stem twang
stages.end_state: airborne, tumbling toward the moss patch, pollen trailing

stages.action: he converts the tumble into an improvised routine — two tight rolls, a bounce off a mushroom cap, a half-twist — each move slightly too big to be graceful
stages.cause: crash momentum he refuses to waste
stages.camera: the track eases wider to hold the whole routine
stages.sound: soft moss impacts, one mushroom-cap boing
stages.end_state: both feet planted on the moss, arms flung up mid-recovery

stages.action: he snaps the recovery into a gymnast's landing pose, chest forward, chin up, and delivers his line in @Audio1 to nobody in particular
stages.cause: sticking a landing he never planned
stages.hold_what: the pose held without extra movement while one pollen flake lands on his nose
stages.end_state: the triumphant pose held, pollen-dusted, one antenna bent — evidence contradicting triumph

camera_policy.policy: track the chaos from a low rear three-quarter, then lock to a medium for the landing button

end_state: Fuzzby alone in a locked medium, holding the pose on the moss patch, pollen-dusted, one antenna bent; the corridor behind shows the trail of snapped petals. Harvest this frame as the opening reference for S1.SH1B.
constraints: Fuzzby is the only character — no second character enters
Maintain his canonical scale against the flowers
Nothing is damaged: petals snap back, the stem recovers, no debris
No gag after the button — once the pose lands, nothing else happens
